data.name: Cloud Nine Limited Edition
data.headline: Nine years. Nine months. Nine freezes. Plus one month on us.
data.benefit: Nine years. Nine months. Nine freezes. Plus one month on us — because we're feeling generous on our birthday. Only 99 numbered memberships in Mumbai and 39 in Bengaluru. When they're gone, they're gone (like your 2018 resolutions).
data.rationale: Kwality's 1M average ticket is ₹16,030; this is ₹1.65L upfront. At ₹16,500/month it sits between 6M list (₹18,953/month) and an annual at 20% (₹14,630/month), so it upsells 1M/3M members without cannibalising annuals. Effective discount vs 10× 1M list: 18.5% Mumbai, 17.8% Bengaluru.
data.audience: Members on 1 Month or class packs.
data.conditions: Long-plan purchase ≤20% effective. Numbered, no extra units added. 15% newcomer/lapsed perks don't stack.
data.kpi: Units sold; repeat purchase at expiry.

scenes.title: Plus One, Plus Nine
scenes.narration: Revenue boost: Plus One, Plus Nine. It's our birthday, so we're giving presents for presents. 5 buyers at 12,406 rupees — 62,030 rupees. 15 per cent off.

data.name: Plus One, Plus Nine
data.headline: Bring a friend, get 9 days. Bring three, get a month.
data.benefit: It's our birthday, so we're giving presents for presents. Bring a friend who joins: +9 days on us. Bring three: a whole free month. They get 15% off and a Cloud Nine tote.
data.rationale: Referral is the best converting source in every studio (22.6–76.1%) and Kwality's third-largest lead source. The reward is only paid when a new client buys, so it is acquisition spend, not discount.
data.conditions: Friend must be new (phone verified). Max 1 free month per member.
data.kpi: Referred buyers (target 2× Apr-26); members with 3 referrals.

scenes.title: Party Crasher Pass
scenes.narration: New clients: Party Crasher Pass. It's our 9th birthday and you're invited. 9 buyers at 11,707 rupees — 1.05 lakh rupees. 20 per cent off.

data.name: Party Crasher Pass
data.headline: It's our 9th birthday and you're invited. 3 classes for ₹999.
data.benefit: It's our 9th birthday and you're invited. 3 classes for ₹999 (Bengaluru ₹699) — including the party class. Love it? Your ₹999 comes off your first month.
data.rationale: 3+ visits convert 73–94%. A paid pass filters no-shows (free trials have no attendance data); crediting it plus the standard 15% lands exactly at a 20% effective discount.
data.conditions: One per person. Effective 20% on conversion.

scenes.title: Where Are They Now?
scenes.narration: Win-backs: Where Are They Now? You joined us. A lot has changed we got. 10 buyers at 12,406 rupees — 1.24 lakh rupees. 20 per cent off.

data.name: Where Are They Now?
data.headline: You joined us in {year}. A lot has changed (we got prettier).
data.benefit: You joined us in {year}. A lot has changed (we got prettier). Come back for our 9th birthday: 15% off, a bonus class for every year you've known us, and a seat at the Throwback Reunion.
data.rationale: A personal anniversary in the brand's anniversary month is a stronger trigger than a generic code. Bandra's reactivation pool is the largest; the reunion is a public attendance moment.
data.audience: Standard lapsed 15% + max 3 bonus classes (≤20% effective on a 12-class pack)
data.conditions: Standard lapsed 15% + max 3 bonus classes (≤20% effective on a 12-class pack).

data.name: Spin Class (Literally)
data.headline: Renew, then spin. Every spin wins.
data.benefit: Renew in April, get 10% off, then spin the Wheel of Nine. Every spin wins — from smoothies to a free month. The odds are printed on the wall, because we're fit, not shady.
data.rationale: April 2026 discount depth was 20.4% at Kwality and 20.6% at Bandra on blanket codes. A sure 10% plus a game worth ~9% keeps the average 1M ticket near ₹18,000 instead of ~₹14,000.
data.conditions: One spin per renewal, ≈19.5% effective at expected value.
data.kpi: 1M average ticket (target ≥₹18,000); spins filmed and shared.

data.name: Club Nine: The Founders' Table
data.headline: Nine numbered seats. Founder perks for a year.
data.benefit: Nine numbered annual seats per studio. Twice the perks: 4 privates, 8 guest passes, 2 hosted classes, a numbered jacket and your name on the Club Nine wall. Public seat counter. No seat ever added.
data.rationale: Kwality sold 34 annuals on a flat 25% code in 2026 (₹9.7L given away). Numbered scarcity, a public counter and perks deliver ≈25% value at a 20% cash discount.
data.conditions: ≈25% effective with perks (annual cap). Leftover seats return on Black Friday.
data.kpi: Seats sold out of 9 per studio; guest-pass → new buyer conversion.
